description: Create a signed receipt recording the supplied content reference and terms, after verifying the governance block against the content and the publisher's key. If the block does not verify, the tool refuses and signs nothing. The receipt captures the block's terms and revocation policy at access time. The tool signs the receipt with agentPrivateKey but returns only a text summary (receipt ID, agent DID, publisher DID, intended usage, governance block status, training term, cached-copy revocation policy). The full signed receipt, including its signature, is not returned. A verified block is not permission to perform intendedUsage, and the receipt is not proof that access happened.

content.description: Content the governance block covers, used to verify its content hash

intendedUsage.description: How you intend to use this content

publisherPublicKey.description: Publisher's Ed25519 public key (hex), used to verify the block signature
